Data:Nxh.n.apollo.morgen.r.resurgences.e.desc: 'Perfect, Librarian, perfect. Now I will have, shall we say, a friend in the right place, at the very best time.'

Data:Nxh.n.apollo.morgen.r.tridesmahiera.desc: 'Perfect, Librarian, perfect. Now I will have, shall we say, a friend in the orchestra.'

Data:Nxh.n.casket.cracked.coquille.r.sig.desc: 'Thank you, darling. It's very difficult to depict something of that stature effectively in art… but I know a talented artist or two, and your book gave me enough insight into the peculiar pigments they needed… he's free, I'm glad to say. Here's the painting, as a sign of our gratitude. Perhaps if you have an altar to the Chancel, you should place it there...'

Data:Nxh.n.casket.cracked.coquille.t.ett.desc: 'Thank you, darling. It's very difficult to depict something of that stature effectively in art… but I know a talented artist or two, and that wicked little book has a great deal to say about inks and imprisonments... if perhaps we frame the Black Flower as Atrament, then... never mind. The Messenger's free. Here's the painting, as a sign of our gratitude. Perhaps if you have an altar to the Chancel, you should place it there...'

Data:Nxh.n.casket.cracked.dagmar.r.sight.desc: 'Well if you can't paint it, eat it, as Solomon Husher never said, probably. Thanks for that. Here's the last of the whole business. Can you put it somewhere safe? Meantersay if you have for instance a special sort of sarcophagus in your cellar somewhere...'

Data:Nxh.n.casket.cracked.dagmar.t.onthe.desc: 'The Messenger? Got 'im! Thanks for the reading materials, what? Here's the last of the whole business. Can you put it somewhere safe? Meantersay if you have for instance a special sort of sarcophagus in your cellar somewhere...'

Data:Nxh.n.casket.cracked.zachary.r.sigh.desc: 'I found the colours, I bought the lines. The Messenger is free. Here: take this, to dwell on your threemost altar. There may then be fewer regrets. I hope.'

Data:Nxh.n.casket.cracked.zachary.t.aman.desc: 'There is a tradition that the Messenger is a foe of serpents. I had never believed it. And now he is free. Here: take this, to dwell on your threemost altar. There may then be fewer regrets. I hope.'

Data:Nxh.n.claw.agdistis.west.agdistis.a.desc: 'You will not make the offering? … honestly, I'm relieved. I think I will pour it into the sea as I depart. Perhaps it will be over then. Thank you, Librarian.'
'The offering is complete? Thank you, Librarian. Don't tell me what happened. If anything did. I am already beginning to wish I had not asked you…''

Data:Nxh.n.claw.patient.unquelled.ehsan..preface: Who knows what it might mean?
Data:Nxh.n.claw.patient.unquelled.ehsan..desc: 'You will not make the offering? Your decision. I'll tell him that. I don't know how he'll take it… thank you, Librarian.'
'Ha! You have made the offering? I had begun to think you might not wish to... I'm a little surprised. Thank you, I think. I almost wish I hadn't asked you. I suppose my patient will be glad...'

Data:Nxh.n.debt.arun.r.disciplines.thesc.desc: ''Wisdom is the daughter of Regret, and regret the son of Wisdom.' It's more elegant than 'Look both ways quickly enough and you get a headache.' But the same principle: we can confuse the Hours long enough to win advantage. The Madrugad will take her due eventually, but I hope that with the great changes that are coming, that might be less important, now...'

Data:Nxh.n.debt.arun.t.againstvitruvius..desc: 'A tower falls, a tower rises...' I know now that's not always true. A balance can be distorted indefinitely. The Madrugad will take her due in the end, but I hope that with the great changes that are coming, that might be less important, now...'

Data:Nxh.n.debt.arun.t.annalsofstbrandan.desc: 'A tower falls, a tower rises...' I know now that's not always true. A balance can be distorted indefinitely. The Madrugad will take her due in the end, but I hope that with the great changes that are coming, that might be less important, now...'

Data:Nxh.n.debt.azita.r.disciplines.thes.desc: 'I don't know how the trick works, but now I know how to work it. Let's see how long I can get away with it. Thank you. Here's something for your trouble.'

Data:Nxh.n.debt.azita.t.demotucorporumve.desc: 'Bones are the key; I think the Elegiast-long already knew it. And it almost makes sense of something I read long ago, that Stars are the bones of Suns. But there my understanding reaches its limits. I don't know how the trick works, but now I know how to work it. Thank you. Here's something for your trouble.'

Data:Nxh.n.debt.connie.r.raggedcrossroad.desc: ''At the cold crossroads waits the Huntress of Snows…' in the White Museum in Zurich there's a relic which I realise now might invoke a Name of the Madrugad. It's less dangerous than speaking to the Madrugad directly - not much, I fear - and it should be an end of it.'

Data:Nxh.n.debt.connie.t.sunsetpassages..desc: 'There's a way then to speak directly to the Madrugad… at a funeral. We never have, alas, any shortage of bodies to bury. I very much hope the Madrugad won't attend in person. As long as she knows what's happening with this 'Wangle', we can end it; and it needs to end, now.'

Data:Nxh.n.endeavour.corso.acted.corso.p.desc: 'Well that caused a fuss and a half. Can't see how they'll trace it back to me, long as you keep discreet, eh Librarian? but I think I might lay low for a bit. I think the war's receded, anyway. No-one else is going to be building a Fissifer, but they'll know what to do about it if anyone does. Balance of power.'

Data:Nxh.n.endeavour.corso.r.pyroglyphic.desc: 'Well that caused a fuss and a half. Can't see how they'll trace it back to me, long as you keep discreet, eh Librarian? but I think I might lay low for a bit. I think the war's receded, anyway. No-one else is going to be building a Fissifer, but they'll know what to do about it if anyone does. Balance of power.'

Data:Nxh.n.endeavour.hokobald.acted.hoko.desc: 'The attempt was made; by my arts, I ensured that the attempt failed; Fissifer remains. I have served the cause of peace today, Librarian. Generosity remains my profoundest flaw.'

Data:Nxh.n.endeavour.hokobald.r.bells.br.desc: 'The attempt was made; by my arts, I ensured that the attempt failed; Fissifer remains. I have served the cause of peace today, Librarian. Generosity remains my profoundest flaw.'

Data:Nxh.n.endeavour.serena.acted.serena.desc: '…we were successful. Fissifer still burns, but he is crippled. And questions will be asked in Parliament, I think. There was blood, Librarian, and there will be more blood. But I hope now that we have averted war.'

'…we were successful. Fissifer still burns, but he is crippled. And questions will be asked in Parliament, I think. There was blood, Librarian, and there will be more blood. But I hope now that we have averted war.'

'…we were successful. Fissifer still burns, but he is crippled. And questions will be asked in Parliament, I think. There was blood, Librarian, and there will be more blood. But I hope now that we have averted war.'

Data:Nxh.n.endeavour.serena.r.glaziery.l.desc: '…we were successful. Fissifer still burns, but he is crippled. And questions will be asked in Parliament, I think. There was blood, Librarian, and there will be more blood. But I hope now that we have averted war.'

Data:Nxh.n.endeavour.serena.r.pyroglyphi.desc: '…we were successful. Fissifer still burns, but he is crippled. And questions will be asked in Parliament, I think. There was blood, Librarian, and there will be more blood. But I hope now that we have averted war.'

Data:Nxh.n.eye.revealed.corso.r.glaziery.desc: 'Tradition. Big bloke I used to know in Beaconsfield used to say tradition was the democracy of the dead. 'Used to' cos he's dead now. Miss him. But I spose that gives him the vote. And he liked tradition. And orthodoxy… look at me getting sentimental. Anyway I think I know now what the nuncio needs to say to Lucia to keep her clear.'

Data:Nxh.n.eye.revealed.corso.t.unhatche.desc: 'Nice one, Librarian. I've heard back and it sounds like it might do the trick. First, it's a nice old jolt of nostalgia for her, and second, it reminds her that even the Solar Hours do change, no matter what the Church says. The stories have her sweet on Ghirbi of the Gate, you know? One day, perhaps, the Hours really will set him free again...

Data:Nxh.n.eye.revealed.hokobald.r.trans.desc: 'The Forge of Days once understood the needs of her Principle, but now, with her Counterfeits and other foolishness, she grows as craven as the Meniscate… I, however, am well supplied with both knowledge and courage. And now, so is Lucia. Perhaps, Librarian, we will greet the new age together, all three of us, hm?'

Data:Nxh.n.eye.revealed.hokobald.t.eachf.desc: 'Omar had insight. Though he was too craven to know what to do with it. I, however, am well supplied with both knowledge and courage. And now, so is Lucia. Perhaps, Librarian, we will greet the new age together, all three of us, hm?'

Data:Nxh.n.eye.revealed.serena.r.sacraso.desc: 'Between you and me, I think the arguments were specious, but Names aren't always as clever as you'd think. Even Lantern-names. Anyway, we've kept Lucia out of the Chandler's clutches; and I'm thinking we could all use a little more independence.'

Data:Nxh.n.eye.revealed.serena.t.sevensh.desc: 'Good thinking. As it was, so it shall be. The Lionsmith's example has kept Lucia out of the Chandler's clutches; and I'm thinking we could all use a little more independence.'

Data:Nxh.n.grunewald.wisp.agdistis.wisp..desc: 'I'm so glad it found a home! I am not always comfortable with those that came before… but it is good that we remember them kindly.'
'Oh! I suppose - if you thought it necessary… perhaps I was naïve. Thank you, Librarian. I will be more careful in future.'

Data:Nxh.n.grunewald.wisp.ehsan.wisp.ski.desc: 'Good to hear it, Librarian. The Carapace has its downside… but I get sentimental about things like this. I hope it does well in its new home.'

Data:Nxh.n.grunewald.wisp.ehsan.wisp.tra.desc: 'Really? Well, I know I'm a soft touch sometimes. If you really think it wasn't safe… I should probably be more careful about Nowhere stuff. A lot more careful.'

Data:Nxh.n.heist.coquille.acted.coquille.desc: 'Think about it for a moment, darling. Someone who's a gifted nyctodromist; someone who knows some of these items, because they used to be her family treasures; someone who's been selling off her family treasures, because they've fallen on hard times. Gräfin Friederike Dagmar Sophia Theresia Helena Benigna von Nagelsburg...'

Data:Nxh.n.heist.hokobald.acted.hokobald.desc: 'It was the von Nagelsburg woman. 'Daymare'.  She had squandered her family fortune, and she could not bear to part with the heirlooms she'd sold. Yes, I am certain. A pity. She had potential.'
